Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: painted orthographic view for a 3D model's albedo texture source.
Input image 1 is the exact grey orthographic model render to EDIT. Input image 2 (design_reference.png) is the approved colour/material design authority ONLY, not a shape or camera reference. Input image 3 (concept_crop.png) supports the design, not the background or lighting.
Primary request: paint only the existing model surfaces in input image 1. Preserve its exact silhouette, alpha mask, image-space position, size, camera, every shape edge, opening and detail. Do not reconstruct or redesign it. Keep every pixel outside its existing silhouette transparent, and all its existing model surfaces covered. Match the guide rather than the reference's three-quarter geometry.
Materials: warm ivory bone plates with fine subtle bone grain and thin branching gold-brown veins following the surfaces, as in the design reference. Muted gold borders on the existing rims. Paint the existing beacon lens blue-white with pale blue/periwinkle internal luminous colour, confined to the lens surface. Existing small rocks at the foot have the reference's muted stone colours, without adding rocks.
Lighting: flat, even, shadowless frontal illumination, an unlit ALBEDO texture source. Uniform material colour independent of surface orientation. No cast shadows, no ambient occlusion or cavity darkening, no directional gradients, no strong specular highlights or reflections, no rim light. Recesses retain material colour, not black shadows. Any glowing surface is painted at its glowing colour only, without light spill or bloom.
Output: one native 1024 x 1024 RGBA PNG with genuine transparent background. Preserve input image 1's framing and unaltered silhouette; no background, no floor, no text, no checkerboard painted into the image.
View-specific invariants: use guide_front.png exactly. This is the front orthographic view with a curved tapering horn pointing to the upper left and a broad grounded lower-right base. The guide's occupied bounding box is x=66..957, y=66..957 on the 1024-square canvas. Preserve the tip at the upper left, the flat base at y=957, the oval-in-projection round beacon around (682,638), its raised rim and central shape, the two pointed lower recesses including their horizontal divider, and every small base spire in its original position. Surface ornament is painted within these locked shapes. Do not substitute the design reference's base or narrower arch.
